rows.message: The page title has a "Category: Subtopic" colon split. Use a dash: "Category - Subtopic".
The page has no complexity: field at the top. Add complexity: beginner, intermediate or advanced. Do not add a Badge by hand.
A data or filter example uses the bool type. EWP and WEC turn a bool into an int. Write int (0 or 1) or string. An RPC line such as "2: bool, true" stays.

fail.src/content/docs/a.mdx:
```yaml
- prefab: x
  data: bool, boss, true
```

pass.src/content/docs/a.mdx:
```yaml
- prefab: x
  data: int, boss, 1
```
2: bool, true
